module.purpose: Exports the main powerSyncCollectionOptions function which creates PowerSync collection configurations with support for multiple typing scenarios (basic, schema-validated, and arbitrary collection types).
module.summary: This file provides the primary entry point for creating PowerSync-enabled collections in TanStack DB. It exports overloaded function signatures for powerSyncCollectionOptions that handle different configuration scenarios: basic SQLite types, schema-validated types, and arbitrary collection types. The implementation manages sync modes (eager and on-demand), diff triggers, pending operations, and transaction handling. It integrates with SQLite for local persistence and provides utilities for serialization and metadata retrieval.
module.businessContext: Enables real-time offline-first data synchronization for TanStack DB collections using PowerSync. Failure breaks offline data consistency and sync reliability.

detail.signature:
export function powerSyncCollectionOptions<
  TTable extends Table,
  TSchema extends StandardSchemaV1<any> = never,
>(config: PowerSyncCollectionConfig<TTable, TSchema>)
detail.returnType: InferPowerSyncOutputType<TTable, TSchema> & TSchema & { utils: PowerSyncCollectionUtils<TTable>; schema: TSchema } & SyncConfig<OutputType, string> (inferred)
preconditions: config.database must be a valid PowerSync database instance
config.table must be a valid table descriptor with viewName and trackMetadata
If syncMode is 'on-demand', restConfig must provide appropriate subset loading hooks
postconditions: Returns a collection options object containing sync, utils, and schema properties
If an explicit schema is provided in config, it is used directly; otherwise a schema is derived from the table via convertTableToSchema
The sync function returned registers a diff trigger that writes deserialized rows into the TanStack DB collection
invariants: DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE is the default value for syncBatchSize when not provided in config
'eager' is the default value for syncMode when not provided in config
The tracked table name is unique per invocation due to random hex suffix, enabling safe use across multiple browser tabs
PendingOperationStore.GLOBAL is a singleton shared across all collection instances
edgeCases: When config lacks an explicit schema, one is derived via convertTableToSchema(table) and cast as TSchema
When deserializationSchema is not provided in config, deserialization falls back to the resolved schema
When onDeserializationError is not provided in config, it defaults to undefined and is called unconditionally on validation failure (will throw TypeError if undefined)
When deserialization validation returns neither 'value' nor 'issues', an unknown error message is generated and thrown
Sync rows are processed in batches of syncBatchSize; the loop continues while currentBatchCount equals syncBatchSize
When the abort controller signal fires, disposeTracking is called to clean up the diff trigger

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Throws Error with validation issues when incoming sync data fails schema validation

stateMutations: Creates a PendingOperationStore.GLOBAL entry for pending operation tracking
Registers a database onChange callback via database.onChangeWithCallback
Creates a diff trigger via database.triggers.createDiffTrigger
Writes to the tracked table (__${viewName}_tracking_${randomHex}) in the database
eventsEmitted: Logs 'Sync is ready for ${viewName} into ${trackedTableName}' when diff trigger setup completes
Logs 'Sync is starting for ${viewName} into ${trackedTableName}' when sync starts
Logs 'Sync has been stopped for ${viewName} into ${trackedTableName}' when sync is stopped
Logs 'Could not start syncing process for ${viewName} into ${trackedTableName}' on eager sync start failure
Logs 'An error has been detected in the sync handler' on diff record flush errors
